E J Roofing & More

Local care for the roof over your home.

E J Roofing & More is a family-owned and operated roofing company serving Tucson and surrounding communities. The company has been in business since 2012, with repair, flat roof, tile, shingle, sealing, and roof cleaning services listed by the Better Business Bureau.

Customers describe the team as professional, responsible, and good at communicating. If something doesn’t look right overhead, reach out and ask what to do next.
